Senses.Explanation: The no-ask-no-answer of the Chan records: the pair gone quiet — the ancient road grass-grown, the rot-fearing lantern, Shitou's slippery stones, the morrow's eighth day, and the staff across the spine for whoever asks. Xuedou Chongxian, invited to the seat at Chengtian in Yuezhou, takes the monk's ask live: asking and answering, guest and host in ranks — and when there is no asking and no answering, what then? The ancient road, grass stretching endless. Pressed — had I not come up, how would you know it so? — his sword cuts no dead man. His own address: makers meet, one squeeze, one press, lift the hem and walk; park the thought and you never grope it — say the ask stands in the answer's place, and everyone nests in grass and trees, Hengchuan Xinggong raises the old double ask: the monk asks Xitang — asking and answering, guest and host in ranks; no asking, no answering — what then? Xitang: afraid it would rot! Asks Changqing: — everyone says they will quit the office, yet who has ever been seen under the trees? And his own turn: all turned back into the word-veins — asking and answering, guest and host in ranks; no asking, no answering — what then? The year's spring already old, the terraces green with shade, Liao'an Qingyu's informal talk: asking and answering, there is buddha, there is way's-law; no asking, no answering — where is the way's law then? He raises the whisk: see it? Cracks it: hear it? Seeing and hearing plain — what is it? Don't rush, don't brush past: the lantern knits its brow to breaking, the pillar laughs aloud. Yezhu Fuhui's evening talk runs the pair on stones: asking and answering — Shitou's road is slippery; no asking, no answering — the morrow's eighth day. Yet even so, you will either flip into boxwood Chan or into Xu Liu's plank-carrying. Right at that time, what is the one line that leaps alone? The cold crag's stone drum struck three points, the ruined temple's bronze bell knocked at the fifth watch, Guantao Daqi raises the same double ask at his evening talk and grades it: two venerables both seen through by one plank-carrying fellow — were someone to ask Gaoting, he would answer: a staff across the spine — since he has surrendered to the yamen, here killing and living have a master, Lüyan He ascends the retreat seat: asking and answering, guest and host in ranks; no asking, no answering — the mystery-dark unjudgeable. Any who know the season and can tell the fortunes, step out and meet me — and once the asking done: the wandering worthies bind the retreat, the hall's elder takes his birthday — two colors, one wager, Shiqi Tongyun takes the summer ask live: asking and answering, guest and host in ranks; no asking, no answering — what then? — Quickly withdraw. The follow-up — strolling, I kick over the moon of the empty realm, nowhere in the great thousand not supreme — and his strike: here, no letting pass.
